name: Critical Thinking
description: Turns a request into a measurable target, and holds the result to it. ESOI Application applies proposed edits to the specs and metrics, Metric Translation turns a request into a metric with a target, Goal Completion says whether the goal was met, and Response Quality judges the response against a quality profile.
purpose: Say what success means for a request and check that it was reached.
approach: Translate the request into a metric, then check the goal and the response quality, each as its own solution.
out_of_scope: Planning and writing the response (the Mind does that), keeping a person's preferences (Representatives do that) and deciding when to ask (Judgment Calls do that).
milestones: 1. The evidence check runs on written answers with and without supporting links. 2. A second arm exists beside it. 3. The selected arm was chosen by the seat's metric.
measures_of_success: Share of unsupported links in written answers that are reported, with no supported link reported.
inputs: A request, its response, the objective and the quality profile.
outputs: A target for a request, whether its goal was met and how good the response is.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: Pass the answer and the evidence text: critique(answer, evidence).

name: Subconscious
description: Finds and prepares information for the Mind. It reads the system's context only through Internal Context; Cards From Files builds the cards, the Context Retriever picks the cards and file pieces a request needs within a token budget, and Intuition offers what comes to mind unasked.
purpose: Give the Mind the information a request needs and nothing from another person's scope: cards, file chunks and memory, found and prepared.
approach: Read what Internal Context returns, pick what bears on the request with the Context Retriever within the scope of the asker, and hand the Mind the cards, the pieces and what Intuition offers, with a step for each.
out_of_scope: Retaining memories (Long-Term Memory does that), storing cards and run records (Internal Context does that) and bringing in the outside (World does that).
milestones: 1. The offline stage of metric-the-subconscious has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 2. The measured stage of metric-the-subconscious has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 3. The selected arm is the one the cascade of metric-the-subconscious chooses (rule S33).
measures_of_success: Right context admitted, nothing from another scope.
inputs: A query, and optionally a folder's files and a token budget.
outputs: The cards, the file pieces and what Intuition offered for a request, with the step of each part.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("the-subconscious", "rust release")` recalls the cards; `prepare` returns what the Mind is handed.

name: Mind
description: What the planning and responding AI can see for one request and how it outputs plans, requests and communications. Context Intake takes in what the Subconscious and the World bring, the Planner breaks the request into pieces, Delegation hands each piece to the right worker only when that is necessary, and the Response Writer outputs the plan, request or communication.
purpose: Turn one request and its context into a plan and a response.
approach: Run the four parts in order, and check the Nervous System signal and Judgment Calls before a risky step.
out_of_scope: Finding the information (Subconscious and World do that), the long view across requests (Higher Mind), deciding whether the goal was met (Critical Thinking) and deciding when to ask a person (Judgment Calls).
milestones: 1. The offline stage of metric-the-mind has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 2. The staged stage of metric-the-mind has a counting result for at least two arms on the same cases. 3. The selected arm is the one the cascade of metric-the-mind chooses (rule S33).
measures_of_success: Answer quality per dollar and per second.
parameters: A model-call seat and a tier-selection seat (built on first use, so a prompt with no tier never asks for it).
inputs: A request, its target, the Representative's authority and the guidance, when there is some.
outputs: A plan, request or communication for one request, with the step of every part of the Mind.
effects: One model call per request, which costs what the provider charges or draws on the operator's subscription.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("the-mind", {"request": ...})` plans, delegates and writes for one request.

name: Higher Mind
description: The long view across requests: Long-Term Memory retains and recalls what happened, Objectives holds the live hierarchy of intents and goals, and Guidance gives the Planner an infrequent longer-term nudge.
purpose: Keep the AI working toward what matters beyond the request in front of it.
approach: Read Objectives, Long-Term Memory and Guidance for one request and hand the result to the Planner and Critical Thinking.
out_of_scope: Finding the information a single request needs (Subconscious does that) and planning one request (the Mind does that).
milestones: 1. The long view survives from one request to the next (metric-higher-mind).
measures_of_success: The long view survives from one request to the next.
outputs: What the AI remembers, what it is working toward and the nudge it should take.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: `hubofhubs.run("higher-mind", {"request": ...})` returns the objectives, the memory and the nudge for a request.
